topic: How to help your teen price their first paid gig
caption:
Most teens underprice themselves and quit before they start.

Here's a simple fix: have your teen look up what others charge locally, then price just slightly under to win their first paying customer.

One paid gig builds more confidence than a hundred scrolling sessions.

copy.headline: Help Your Teen Price Their First Gig Right
copy.body: Have your teen check what 3 neighbors or classmates would pay for the same service, then set their rate 10-15% lower to land that first client fast.
